icp.name: Scraping Engineer
icp.description: Technical professional responsible for building and maintaining web data extraction pipelines.

problems: Uncertainty whether proxies are routing traffic correctly before launch.
Inability to debug request headers or IP geolocation issues in isolation.
Lack of a standardized test payload to validate scraper output formats.
Risk of undetected blocking when moving from staging to production environments.
